turns.text: revisa porque smith ui --pages-publish no funciona para lanzar github pages

The cause is the flag name. `--pages-publish` doesn't exist in `smith ui`. The real flag is **`--publish-pages`**, and argparse rejects the wrong one before doing anything:

```
smith ui: error: unrecognized arguments: --pages-publish
```

Everything else is already set up:
- The remote `origin` points to GitHub (`[ACCOUNT]/qmleegV2`, a public repo).
- `gh` is logged in as `[ACCOUNT]`.
- Pages is turned on and serves the `gh-pages` branch. Its status is `built`, and https://[ACCOUNT].github.io/qmleegV2/ returns 200.
- The last snapshot was published today at 19:43 (-0500). That one went out with the correct flag.

To republish:

```
smith ui . --publish-pages
```

It asks you to confirm interactively. Add `--yes` to skip that, or `--no-ai-history` to leave out the AI history. The site is **public**, and it includes the PDF and figures as they are.

Want me to run it? If so, tell me whether to include the masked AI history.
